dedupe_keys.name: 3d vision pipeline data for rosella framework

description: 3D vision pipeline data for ROSELLA framework is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by CSIRO Data Access Portal. This data collection accompanies the DICTA'25 paper "ROSELLA: an Open Computer Vision and Measurement Toolkit for Advanced Manufacturing" and contains data streams from the hardware interface, including RGB images, depth maps, and (optionally) the corresponding robot/camera poses to generate a fused point cloud and/or mesh using tools provided in ROSELLA toolkit. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher CSIRO Data Access Portal. It offers 939 resource(s) in html, json, txt. The portal shows 2025-12-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
